highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.5 retires built-in RAW and DNG decoding.

breaking.title: Use an external decoder for RAW and DNG images
breaking.body: Built-in RAW/DNG decoding and PIEX extraction of embedded JPEG previews are disabled; no replacement reader is included. Decode these files externally before passing pixels to SkiaSharp. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng remains for compatibility, but does not indicate codec support. Standalone JPEG decoding is unchanged.

v4.150.5.headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.5 removes built-in RAW/DNG decoding and embedded RAW-preview extraction.
